scope: Simulates all 18 family members (3 put modes x 3 channel modes x 2 trigger states) and keeps those consistent with calibration receipts; answers only when all consistent members agree.
lesson: The channel is not net committed effects: changes() reflects the last statement's direct row changes, total_changes accumulates per connection, and an AFTER INSERT trigger adds one to total_changes but not to changes(). REPLACE counts a row change even when the value is unchanged, while IGNORE and DO UPDATE do not. Filtering the family by receipts and intersecting predictions preserves uncertainty for underdetermined goals.
